cmd: uv run --extra dev python -m pytest -q -k skill

uv run python -c "import json,tempfile,pathlib; from nexuscli.skill.propose import run_post_landing_diff; tmp=tempfile.mkdtemp(); rec={'name':'rule-demo','applied_versions':[1]}; out=run_post_landing_diff(rec, cwd='.', runner=None, confirm=lambda r: True); pl=out.get('post_landing'); assert pl and pl.get('after',{}).get('status') in ('pass','fail'), out; before=json.loads(pathlib.Path('.nexuscli/evals/last-real-report.json').read_text()); assert before['summary']['scenarios_total']>=2, before['summary']; print('POST-LANDING-OK after=', pl['after']['status'], '| report restored:', pl.get('report_restored', True))"
